assessment: The paper has gained in strength by the addition of new MATR3 CLIP–seq and Hi–C data and more computational and gene expression analyses. This manuscript gives important insight about the mechanisms by which lncRNA regulate heart development. The authors used convincing methods to show that pCharme interacts with MATR3 to form nuclear aggregates necessary to control cardiac genes transcription program. In the absence of this lncRNA, cardiomyocyte maturation is affected and leads to cardiac dysfunction.
